title: Handle opt-outs yourself
alias: inbound message webhook + send_sms + a checked record
summary: Your webhook handler records a STOP from the inbound message webhook and confirms it with a send_sms document. Every later send checks that record before it makes a request, so a refused send is never a request. The handler accepts the webhook only with SignalWire's signature over it.
scenario: A bike shop that texts repair updates and must stop the moment a customer says so

evidence: https://signalwire.com/docs/platform/messaging (fetched 2026-09-02): customers are responsible for handling inbound stop requests; no send again unless opted back in via Unstop
tools/openapi/rest.json webhooks inbound_message_webhook: message{from,to,body,type,...} required; the URL answers with SWML
schema.json SendSMS/SMSWithBody: to_number, from_number, body required; sections.main [] validates
sdk 3.0.1 has no messaging namespace; send goes through RestClient._http
